$comment: changelog §R13, R13-1 (R12-2's split, its scope): every llm-graded PASS-if line in skills/*/evals/evals.json that joins conditions is one judge per condition. splits: each joined line before and its judges after, in place. single: every judge the join heuristic in r13-1-judge-splits.test.ts flags that stays one judge, with why (note: the case's $comment says why, R13-1's 'one fact stated two ways'). counts: llm judges per case after the split. The R13 refix (its verifier's F1–F4) splits what that sweep kept as one where the parts can fail apart: an item with its attributes, a quotation with its label or source tag, content with its order, two numbers named as one basis; what stays one is a value with its own uncertainty, basis or id, a named set, a prohibition's scope, one comparison against the base trajectory, or one fact said two ways.
